abort.already_configured: This lock already has a Yale Access Bluetooth Keypad entry.
abort.no_locks: No lock is available. A lock is listed when Yale Access Bluetooth has loaded it and it has no Yale Access Bluetooth Keypad entry yet.

communication_error.message: Failed to communicate with the lock.

invalid_pin.message: The PIN must be {min} to {max} digits.

invalid_response.message: The lock returned an invalid response.

invalid_slot.message: The slot must be from {min} to {max}.

keycode_error.message: The lock rejected the keypad request: {error}

keycode_no_space.message: The lock answered KEYCODE_NOSPACE (0x07) to the {step} step. The slot was cleared before that step and is now empty.

keycode_slot_in_use.message: The lock answered KEYCODE_SLOT_IN_USE (0x45) to the {step} step. The slot was cleared before that step and is now empty.

keycode_timeout.message: The lock answered KEYCODE_TIMEOUT (0x08) to the {step} step. The slot was cleared before that step and is now empty.

lock_not_configured.message: The lock of {entity_id} has no Yale Access Bluetooth Keypad entry.

lock_not_running.message: The lock connection is not running.

master_code_slot.message: Slot {slot} is the master code's slot in the lock's cloud record, which the set and clear actions do not write or clear. Nothing was sent to the lock.

no_keypad.message: The lock's cloud record shows no keypad. Nothing was sent to the lock.

no_lock_targeted.message: The action targets no Yale Access Bluetooth lock.

owner_not_loaded.message: Yale Access Bluetooth has not loaded this lock

pin_already_in_use.message: This code already exists on the lock, which answered KEYCODE_EXISTING_KEY (0x06) to the {step} step. The slot was cleared before that step and is now empty.

pin_in_use.message: This PIN is already assigned to slot {slot}. Nothing was sent to the lock.

slot_holds_other_pin.message: The lock answered that slot {slot} holds a PIN other than the one this integration wrote there. Nothing was written to the lock, and this integration no longer keeps a PIN for that slot.

slot_in_use.message: Slot {slot} is assigned to a PIN in the lock's cloud record. Nothing was sent to the lock.

slot_not_empty.message: The lock answered that slot {slot} holds a PIN, and this integration has no record of writing one there. Nothing was written to the lock.

data_description.status_result: Adds result to the status action's answer: pin, empty, the name of the lock's refusal, malformed, or timeout. None of these raises an error. credential_exists is null unless the result is pin or empty.

clear_lock_credential.description: Clears a keypad PIN from a slot on the lock.

credential_type.name: Credential type

clear_lock_credential.name: Clear lock credential

credential_type.name: Credential type

get_lock_credential_status.name: Get lock credential status

credential_type.name: Credential type

name.name: Name
